# mabinogi-006 — establishment log (2026-11-12)

Evans 1907 cols 47 l. 27 – 55 l. 6 (PDF pp. 56–60). Every column read on the page image (zoom 6, four crops per
column). Base: Evans's letters as on the image; the second witness used only to locate disagreements and for
punctuation shape (the pilot's practice). 6-shaped w → w; r-rotunda → r; ſ → s; raised letters into the line;
line-end marks, Evans's accents, underlines, the asterisk (col 48 l. 31, "lonyd * idaw") and the tick mark
(col 48 l. 23, "iwerdon' am") dropped.

Tooling note: page.py's `--clip` gives shifted crops on these pages (the scan has two overlaid images of different
size). Crops were cut from a full-page render (zoom 6) instead. PyMuPDF is installed for python3.13 here; the
plain `python3` did not see it.

## Opening
- col 47 l. 27 — "Dilit ymdidan" begins mid-line after "goreu a welas neb."; no large initial.

## Worklist items (27 check + 17 loss), decided on the image
OCR misreadings of Evans's sorts where the witness agrees with the image (ss for ſſ, w for 6, r for r-rotunda,
minim clusters, dropped letters): col 47 ll. 32 (chyuedach), 33 (llessach); col 48 ll. 17 (A guedy), 19; col 49
ll. 2 (heb y wyr wrth Uatholwch par weithon — Evans prints this line in a condensed size), 4 (y Gymry), 13
(llythyr), 14 (a'r amharch), 16, 23; col 50 ll. 8 (Minasgwrn, Llayssar), 14 (kynweisyat), 18 (namyn), 19
(A guedy), 21 (oreskynwys), 23, 29 (rodo); col 51 ll. 3 (eskeir), 12 (a wnn); col 52 ll. 16, 36 (ys kymeraf);
col 53 ll. 30 (hynny), 34, 35 (Sef); col 54 ll. 5 (Kedyrn), 17, 21 (o'r hollwyr), 27 (ual y guascassei),
29 (ymedewis), 36 (Iwerdon).

Where Evans differs from the witness (Evans adopted):
- col 48 l. 19 — **"Guern uab Matholwch"** (witness "ab").
- col 50 l. 26 — **"o achaws dremynt"**: no *e* before *dremynt* on the image (witness "e dremynt").
- col 51 l. 21 — **"Nyt oed long"** (witness "Nyd").
- col 52 l. 6 — **"a llynghes"** (witness "llynges").
- col 52 l. 8 — **"kennedyf"** (witness "kynnedyf").
- col 52 l. 10 — **"hitheu"**: *h* raised over "hiteu", into the line (witness agrees).
- col 53 l. 4 — **"attat ti"** (witness "atat").
- col 54 l. 10 — **"un o'r Guydyl"** (witness "Gwydyl").
- col 54 l. 34 — **"cad barawt"**: two words, a clear space on the image (witness "cadbarawt"; Red Book "cat barawt").

Raised (inserted) words:
- col 50 l. 22 — **"o gerd"** written above "aoed arwest" — into the line: "ac a oed o gerd arwest" (witness agrees).

Scribal slips kept as printed, for the drafter's notes:
- col 49 l. 6 — **"carchara wynt ua na at trachefyn"**: *ua* is certain on the image. The witness supplies "[ac]" in
  its place; the Red Book reads "carchara 6ynt hyt nat elont dracheuyn". Kept; sense probably 'and do not let
  (them) back' (*ua* for *a*/*ac*?) — uncertain, the note to say so.
- col 50 ll. 9–10 — **"Phendaran Dyuet dyuet"**: *dyuet* repeated across the line break (dittography; Red Book
  "aphendaram dyuet"). Kept, the note to say so.
- col 50 l. 30 — **"heb vy"** with *v* (witness agrees; elsewhere *wy*). Kept, glossed under *wy*.
- col 54 l. 24 — **"a fawb"** = *a phawb* (spirant of *pawb* spelt f; Red Book "apha6b"). Kept.

Blanks and layout (no words supplied):
- col 53 ll. 15–16 — spaces left in "Arglwyd heb wy [ ] nyt oes / it gynghor [ ] namyn un" (flaw in the vellum); the
  sense is complete; printed continuously.
- col 54 ll. 15–16 — short line "adaw hwnnw adodi" and a space in "y law ar un [ ] arall" (as the packet notes);
  printed continuously.

Witness supplements not supplied: "[e]" in "ymw[e]let" (col 48 l. 8: Evans "e ymwlet"); "[ac]" (col 49 l. 6).
Nothing supplied from the Red Book.

## Word division and layout (ours)
- "yuelly" (as in 004–005); "yg Kymry", "yg Kaer Seint", "yg kyuanned", "yg kylch" as in the witness.
- col 52 l. 1 — Evans "ygwaelawt" (single g) divided **"y gwaelawt"** ('in the bottom', nasalised *gwaelawt* after
  y(n), as "y mywn"); the witness prints one word.
- "y mywn" (cols 53, 54; witness "ymywn"), the majority practice of 002–005; "ymlaen", "ymysc" as the witness.
- "Walltgrwn" one word as the witness (Evans breaks the line after "wallt").
- col 55 ll. 1, 6 — Evans "yr ty", "yr mab" (= y + 'r) written **"y'r ty"**, **"y'r mab"**.
- The englyn (col 54 ll. 31–33) is set as its own paragraph, in quotes, as prose with commas.
- The Irish noblemen's counsel (col 51) put in “ ” (the witness used ‘ ’).
